svg.title: A DAG does not mean one robot at a time
svg.desc: Left: an action DAG for two AGVs and a bay. Right: one execution of it in time. Only the edges force waiting; everything else runs concurrently.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The DAG is a partial order. An edge u -> v only says v may not start before u

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: ends. Two actions with no path between them may run at the same time, and

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: with two AGVs they usually do.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A topological order (e.g. bay, A1, B1, A2, B2, ...) is one way to list the same

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: actions so every edge points forward. The scheduler uses it to replay events

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: on a DiscreteGarageState and to build the response array. It is a

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: bookkeeping order, not the order robots move in.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Every edge removes some parallelism. Per-AGV chains are physical (one

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: AGV, one action at a time). Others, such as rule B inside one job or

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: REBALANCE serialising bays, are choices that can cost throughput.

g.text: The response is ActionNode[] where each node lists its parents. Motion planning produces timed trajectories in which several AGVs move at once (see the ContinuousStateToSchedule

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: test, where AGVs 1 and 2 both start at t = 0). Waiting happens only along edges.
